A Supreme Court inquiry is mandatory for the removal of members.
Articles 315–323 under Part XIV are frequently asked in Indian competitive exams.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Articles 315–323 in Part XIV of the Constitution govern Public Service Commissions.
At least half of the commission members must have 10 years of prior government experience.
Removal of a member requires a mandatory inquiry by the Supreme Court.
All commission expenses are charged directly on the Consolidated Fund of India.
The Chairman is completely ineligible for further employment under the government.
